about: Card numbers in transcripts, for any implementation of District Assurance redaction and live detection (SPEC.md, section 24). Every card number here is a public test number. `runs`: the digits of each run a text holds, in order. `redact`: the text after card-number redaction; the marker is "[card number removed]". `live`: chunks fed one at a time to a live detector with the default threshold of 8 digits unless `minDigits` is set; after each chunk, whether it signals an interrupt and how many digits the run still open at the end holds.
